name: Story Generation Workflow
description: Generates characters and a story outline based on a theme.

variables.name: country
variables.description: The country where the  story happen and characters live.
variables.default_value: Velmora: A lush, ancient kingdom where magic flows through the land itself. Wizards govern with wisdom, and enchanted forests whisper secrets of forgotten spells.
options: Velmora: A lush, ancient kingdom where magic flows through the land itself. Wizards govern with wisdom, and enchanted forests whisper secrets of forgotten spells.
Drakthar Dominion: A mountainous empire ruled by dragonlords. Its people bond with dragons from birth, forging a society built on fire, flight, and fierce honor.
Gearhollow: A gritty, soot-stained steampunk nation powered by steam, gears, and innovation. Skyships patrol brass cities while rebels tinker in hidden workshops.
Xerathuun: A cryptic desert land scattered with alien monoliths and glowing artifacts. Its people wield incomprehensible technology and speak in riddles older than time.
